## Patterns

| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `sdk-init-testnet` | Initialize EvoSDK for testnet in trusted mode and connect | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted({ settings: { timeoutMs: 8000 } }); await sdk.connect();` |
| `sdk-init-mainnet` | Initialize EvoSDK for mainnet in trusted mode | `const sdk = EvoSDK.mainnetTrusted(); await sdk.connect();` |
| `sdk-init-custom-addresses` | Initialize with custom masternode addresses | `const sdk = EvoSDK.withAddresses(['https://52.12.176.90:1443'], 'testnet'); await sdk.connect();` |
| `wasm-init` | One-time WASM initialization before using WASM classes | `import initWasm, * as wasmSdk from '@dashevo/wasm-sdk/compressed'; await initWasm();` |
| `identity-fetch` | Fetch identity and get JSON representation | `const identity = await sdk.identities.fetch(identityId); const json = identity.toJSON();` |
| `identity-balance` | Fetch identity balance as bigint, convert to number | `const balance = await sdk.identities.balance(identityId); const credits = Number(balance);` |
| `identity-create-asset-lock` | Create identity from asset lock proof | `const proof = AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(isLock, txBytes, outIdx); const identity = new Identity(proof.createIdentityId()); identity.addPublicKey(new IdentityPublicKey({...})); const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif); await sdk.identities.create({ identity, assetLockProof: proof, assetLockPrivateKey: PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif), signer });` |
| `identity-update-add-key` | Add a new key to an existing identity | `const identity = await sdk.identities.fetch(id); const newKey = new IdentityPublicKeyInCreation(keyId, 'ENCRYPTION', 'MEDIUM', 'ECDSA_SECP256K1', false, pubKeyBytes, null, null); const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(masterKeyWif); await sdk.identities.update({ identity, addPublicKeys: [newKey], signer });` |
| `identity-top-up` | Top up identity from asset lock | `const proof = AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(...); await sdk.identities.topUp({ identity, assetLockProof: proof, assetLockPrivateKey: PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif) });` |
| `contract-fetch` | Fetch and cache a data contract | `const contract = await sdk.contracts.fetch(contractId);` |
| `document-query` | Query documents with where/orderBy/limit | `const docs = await sdk.documents.query({ dataContractId, documentTypeName: 'domain', where: [['normalizedLabel', 'startsWith', 'test']], orderBy: [['normalizedLabel', 'asc']], limit: 10 });` |
| `document-get-single` | Get single document by ID | `const doc = await sdk.documents.get(contractId, 'post', documentId); const json = doc.toJSON();` |
| `document-create-manual-st` | Build document creation ST manually for idempotent retry | `const doc = new Document(data, typeName, 1n, contractId, ownerId); const createTx = new DocumentCreateTransition(doc, nonce, null, null); const batched = new BatchedTransition(createTx.toDocumentTransition()); const batch = BatchTransition.fromBatchedTransitions([batched], ownerId, 0); const st = batch.toStateTransition(); st.setIdentityContractNonce(nonce); st.sign(PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif), identityKey);` |
| `document-replace` | Replace/update a document | `const doc = new Document(data, typeName, BigInt(newRevision), contractId, ownerId, docId); const { signer, identityKey } = await signerService.createSignerFromWasmKey(wif, wasmKey); await sdk.documents.replace({ document: doc, identityKey, signer });` |
| `document-delete` | Delete a document | `await sdk.documents.delete({ document: { id: docId, ownerId, dataContractId, documentTypeName }, identityKey, signer });` |
| `dpns-register` | Register a DPNS username | `const identity = await sdk.identities.fetch(id); const key = identity.getPublicKeyById(keyId); const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif); await sdk.dpns.registerName({ label, identity, identityKey: key, signer, preorderCallback: () => console.log('preorder done') });` |
| `dpns-resolve` | Resolve DPNS name to identity ID | `const identityId = await sdk.dpns.resolveName('alice');` |
| `dpns-check-available` | Check DPNS name availability | `const available = await sdk.dpns.isNameAvailable('myname');` |
| `dpns-validate` | Validate and normalize username | `const valid = await sdk.dpns.isValidUsername(label); const contested = await sdk.dpns.isContestedUsername(label); const safe = await sdk.dpns.convertToHomographSafe(label);` |
| `dpns-get-usernames` | Get all usernames for an identity | `const names = await sdk.dpns.usernames({ identityId, limit: 20 }); const primary = await sdk.dpns.username(identityId);` |
| `token-mint` | Mint tokens | `await sdk.tokens.mint({ contractId, tokenPosition: 0, amount: '100', identityId, signer });` |
| `token-transfer` | Transfer tokens between identities | `await sdk.tokens.transfer({ contractId, tokenPosition: 0, amount: '10', identityId, recipientId, signer });` |
| `token-query-balance` | Query token balances | `const balances = await sdk.tokens.balances([id1, id2], tokenId); const supply = await sdk.tokens.totalSupply(tokenId);` |
| `epoch-current` | Get current epoch info | `const epoch = await sdk.epoch.current();` |
| `system-status` | Get platform status | `const status = await sdk.system.status();` |
| `address-transfer` | Transfer between platform addresses | `const signer = new PlatformAddressSigner(); const addr = signer.addKey(PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif)); const input = new PlatformAddressInput(addr, 0n, 100000n); const output = new PlatformAddressOutput(recipient, 90000n); await sdk.addresses.transfer({ inputs: [input], outputs: [output], signer });` |
| `proof-query` | Query with proof verification | `const result = await sdk.identities.fetchWithProof(identityId); // result has proof metadata` |
| `signer-create` | Create signer for state transitions | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(privateKeyWif);` |
| `key-find-matching` | Find identity key matching a private key | `const match = findMatchingKeyIndex(wif, identityPublicKeys, 'testnet'); // returns { keyId, securityLevel, purpose }` |
| `hd-derive-identity-keys` | Derive identity keys from HD mnemonic | `const keys = generateDefaultIdentityKeysHD('testnet', mnemonic); // 5 keys: Master, HighAuth, CriticalAuth, Transfer, Encryption` |
| `nonce-management` | Manual nonce management for idempotent STs | `const nonce = await sdk.wasm.getIdentityContractNonce(ownerId, contractId); const seqNum = nonce & ((1n << 40n) - 1n); const newNonce = seqNum + 1n;` |
| `st-rebroadcast` | Cache and rebroadcast state transition for reliability | `const stBytes = st.toBytes(); savePendingSTBytes(docId, stBytes); // On retry: const cachedST = StateTransition.fromBytes(loadPendingSTBytes(docId)); await wasm.broadcastStateTransition(cachedST);` |
| `map-response-to-array` | Convert SDK Map response to document array | `const docs = Array.from(response.values()).filter(Boolean).map(d => d.toJSON());` |
| `sdk-singleton` | Singleton SDK service pattern with reconnection | `class EvoSdkService { private sdk: EvoSDK \| null = null; async getSdk() {...} async handleConnectionError(err) {...} }` |
| `legacy-document-create` | Legacy document creation pattern | `const doc = await client.platform.documents.create('appName.docType', identity, { field: 'value' }); await client.platform.documents.broadcast({ create: [doc] }, identity);` |
| `legacy-name-register` | Legacy DPNS registration (preorder + domain) | `await client.platform.names.register('alice.dash', { identity: identity.getId() }, identity);` |
